blocks.body:
name = "acme/judges-brief"
version = "1.0.0"
[verifier.judges.agent]
brief = "https://example.com/brief.md"

[verifier.judges.vlm]
brief = "sandbox/brief.md"

[verifier.judges.llm]
brief = "verifier/nope.md"

[verifier.judges.panel]
brief = ""

diagnostics.message: [verifier.judges.llm] brief verifier/nope.md is not in the package
[verifier.judges.vlm] brief sandbox/brief.md must be a file under verifier/, which only grading sees; anywhere else the agent could read it
[verifier.judges.agent] brief https://example.com/brief.md is a URL, and briefs are files in the package: copy the shared brief into verifier/, and apply a change across a dataset's tasks with a tool
[verifier.judges.panel] brief names a markdown file under verifier/
the agent judge has no token budget ([verifier.judges.agent] budget = { tokens = ... }): here it is bounded by its timeout, 20m, but purpose = "rl" and delivery grade require one
